meta.title: Lumino — Digital studio | Websites built to measure
meta.description: Digital studio: we design and build websites to measure. Identity, interfaces and motion for restaurants, hotels, companies and retail.
meta.ogImageAlt: Lumino — We design and build websites people remember

hero.srTitle: Lumino — digital studio. We design and build websites people remember.

about.body1Before: The difference isn’t size: it’s who answers. Here a project doesn’t get handed between departments —
about.body1Strong: whoever designs it is the one who writes it
about.body1After: , and it stays the same person from the first sketch to the line of code that goes live.
about.body2: We take on few projects at a time, because a site done properly means understanding a trade before representing it. We look at how you work, what you sell, who walks through the door. Then we build something that looks like you, not like somebody else’s template.

works.title: What we’ve built.
works.lead: Hover a card to watch the site scroll. Click to open it and browse it for real, without leaving this page.
works.openNewTabLong: Open the site in a new tab →

steps.title: An opening that stops the thumb
steps.body: The first screen decides whether they stay or leave. We build openings that look like nothing else: typography that reacts, media that breathes, no templates.

steps.title: Motion made to measure
steps.body: Every animation has a reason. Motion guides the eye where it’s needed, tells the product’s story, and stays under 60 milliseconds of response.

steps.title: Phone first
steps.body: 80% of your customers arrive on mobile. We design there first, then widen out. Loading under two seconds, every time.

sectors.lead: The trade changes, the method doesn’t. Every sector has its own way of being chosen: our job is working out what yours is.

items.name: Restaurants
items.body: The menu is the product: it has to be updated the same day, read with a thumb and found on Google. Bookings that land straight on the floor, with no middleman keeping a percentage.
builds: A menu you update yourself, without calling us
Bookings that land straight on the floor
Food photography treated properly
Google reviews that update on their own

items.name: Hotels
items.body: Every direct booking is a commission you don’t pay. Rooms told one by one, availability that’s always true, and a site that changes as the season changes.
builds: Rooms told one by one
Direct booking, no commission
Availability always in step with your system
A site that changes as the season changes

items.name: Companies
items.body: Whoever is looking at you is looking at three others too. The site has to say in thirty seconds what you do, for whom, and why it’s you — then hand the sales team material that holds up in comparison.
builds: A visual identity that holds together everywhere
A catalogue that’s browsable and always current
Material the sales team will actually use
Enquiries that arrive qualified

items.name: Retail
items.body: The shop and the online shop are the same shop. A catalogue that flicks through fast, real availability, and a reason to come in and collect rather than wait for a courier.
builds: A catalogue you can flick through with a thumb
Real availability, shop by shop
Click and collect as a choice, not a fallback
A storefront that brings people in

items.name: Real estate
items.body: A property sells on the photographs and on the path that leads to them. Listings that read on a phone during a break, and a viewing request that arrives before the competition’s.
builds: Listings that read over a coffee break
Photographs and floor plans treated properly
A viewing request in two taps
Search that actually filters
